site: Workday (R. L. Polk Mobility, wd503); any site that refuses a new account until its email is verified
class: An account the agent had just created was not counted as one the site knows, so a refused sign-in went to the owner without the approved recoveries
symptom: After Create Account, Workday showed neither Candidate Home nor the application; the one sign-in got 'You may have entered the wrong email address or password or your account might be locked.' and the run stopped for the owner.
root_cause: account_state._knows_account counted only an account on record or an email the site took; 'created here in this run' did not count, so WRONG_PASSWORD went to FOR_OWNER instead of the verification link or the reset to the ATS password (CLAUDE.md §5). verify_account_by_email_link also opened the mail only on a page that says 'verify', which Workday's refusal never does.
why_tests_missed: The refused-password tests covered an account on record or an email the site took, and the verification tests a page that says 'verify'; none had a refusal right after a creation.
fix: _knows_account includes memory.created. WRONG_PASSWORD on a just-created account: VERIFY_BY_LINK first (verify_account_by_email_link(just_created=True) accepts a refused sign-in page), then RESET_PASSWORD at once if no link came, then the owner.
prevention: What the agent itself did on a site in this run is evidence about the account; decide recoveries with it, not only with what the page says.
